title: Gonorrhea screening in sexually active women 24 years or younger

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends screening for gonorrhea in all sexually active women 24 years or younger and in women 25 years or older who are at increased risk for infection.

denominator.quote: all sexually active women 24 years or younger

derived.window: text states no screening interval; a test within the measurement year is assumed and requires human review
